summary: Tested all 3 bug fixes for Mopado app. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests passed - season/episode creation flows, GET episodes after POST, duplicate reward prevention (mopado_earned=0, already_completed=true), and register/login. Frontend: verified full logout flow end-to-end - login as famille.test@mopado.fr -> Profile tab -> logout button (testID=logout-button) -> ConfirmModal appears -> confirm 'Déconnexion' -> redirected to /login -> 'Créer un compte' link opens /register form. All 3 reported bugs are FIXED. Note: expo-video import includes deprecated 'Video' export (unused) at session/[episodeId].tsx:18 - minor cleanup only.

minor.issue: Broad try/except returns HTTP 400 for any error (including invalid ObjectId) instead of 404/422 - minor error-code hygiene.
No JWT verification middleware on any protected endpoint (family/session/episode routes accept any family_id). Not part of current bugs but worth flagging.

react_native_issues.issue: Imports deprecated 'Video' named export from expo-video (unused). Only VideoView + useVideoPlayer are needed. Reference: /app/frontend/app/session/[episodeId].tsx:18

action_items: Optional: remove unused 'Video' import from expo-video in /app/frontend/app/session/[episodeId].tsx:18 (deprecated symbol).
Consider adding JWT auth middleware on family/session endpoints (out of scope but flagged).
Consider showing an 'all episodes completed' state on home rather than the last-completed episode when nothing is uncompleted (currently falls back silently).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py catches broad Exception on many routes returning HTTP 400 - should differentiate ObjectId validation vs not-found (404) vs server errors (500).
AuthContext logout only clears local storage; server has no session invalidation (stateless JWT, acceptable).
seed_data_creation: Test seasons/episodes created and cleaned up. A new TEST_bug2_* user was created for isolation (not cleaned - low volume, prefixed with TEST_).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 bugs verified fixed. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_mopado_bugs.py (pytest). Frontend logout uses ConfirmModal with testIDs: logout-button, confirm-modal-confirm, confirm-modal-cancel. Test creds famille.test@mopado.fr/test123 work.
rca_of_issue: BUG 1 root cause was home.tsx only loading episodes from first season - fixed via loop across all seasons + useFocusEffect. BUG 2 was missing check on completed_episodes array - fixed in complete_session endpoint via `if episode_id in user.completed_episodes -> return already_completed=true, mopado_earned=0`. BUG 3 was Alert.alert not firing on web - fixed by replacing with custom ConfirmModal (react-native Modal).
